content.description: Iteration 2: queues are 5x too long and discharge headways 2-3x too slow in all iteration-1 specs, so speed up car-following (tau, accel, minGap) as the main change; strengthen red running and early start, which stayed near zero; keep seeking at the s00 level that matched M9a/M10a; shorten box-waiter hold via jmTimegapMinor.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car (sim 1.6 s vs obs 0.39 s discharge headway, R 10), M5/length (sim 74 m vs 13 m) and the M6 car approach times (sim 120-290 s vs 33-41 s): the queues are far too long because discharge is too slow, so tau is lowered 2.5 -> 1.2 s, accel raised 1.2 -> 2.0 m/s2 and minGap to its 1.0 m bound, which shortens the headway and the queue. Same values as car_saval so only the seeking rule differs; Share 0.95 leaves 0.05 for car_seeker.

Targets M1/car (sim 1.6 s vs obs 0.39 s discharge headway, R 10), M5/length (sim 74 m vs 13 m) and the M6 car approach times (sim 120-290 s vs 33-41 s): the queues are far too long because discharge is too slow, so tau is lowered 2.5 -> 1.2 s, accel raised 1.2 -> 2.0 m/s2 and minGap to its 1.0 m bound, which shortens the headway and the queue. Same values as car_saval so only the seeking rule differs; Share 0.05 targets M9b/share_blocked (s00 with 0.05 gave M9a 0.36 close to obs 0.33, but blocked share 0.11 vs 0.02), keeping right-lane use rare.

Targets M1/moto (sim 0.82-0.96 s vs obs 0.30 s, R 19), M5/length and M6 moto approach times: tau lowered 0.8 -> 0.5 s, accel raised 1.1 -> 3.0 m/s2 (still below the SUMO motorcycle default 6) and minGap 1.9 -> 1.2 m, so riders discharge faster after green and queues shorten; minGapLat stays at 0.3 m. Share 0.85 leaves 0.15 for moto_seeker.

Targets M1/moto (sim 0.82-0.96 s vs obs 0.30 s, R 19), M5/length and M6 moto approach times: tau lowered 0.8 -> 0.5 s, accel raised 1.1 -> 3.0 m/s2 (still below the SUMO motorcycle default 6) and minGap 1.9 -> 1.2 m, so riders discharge faster after green and queues shorten; minGapLat stays at 0.3 m. Share 0.15 gave M10a 0.21 vs obs 0.27 in s00, so it is kept to stay near that target.

Targets M7a/release_time (sim 15-53 s vs obs 2.6 s), M7b/clear_lag (10-30 s vs 6.7 s) and M6 illegal_l junction time: jmTimegapMinor lowered 1.0 -> 0.7 s so box waiters accept smaller gaps and leave sooner once the opposing stream thins; riding values as moto_saval (faster discharge, M1/moto). Share 1 is required (sole archetype of its distribution).

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto (sim 0.005 vs obs 0.092, R 17) and M3/per_cycle (0.15-0.2 vs 4.4): p0 0.1-0.2 in iteration 1 gave 5-7x too few red runners (about a third of drawn runs did not complete before red ended), so p0 is raised to the Saval 0.5; k = 0.1 with cap 0.8 adds clustering to lift M3/var_to_mean from about 1.0 toward 1.3.

Targets M2/early/moto (sim 0.01 vs obs 0.13, R 3) and M2/first_delay (sim 5-7 s vs 2.1 s): p 0.13-0.3 gave only 0.01 share since only front-row riders are drawn and about half did not cross before red ended, so p is raised to 0.8; t_before_green 8 s lies within the 4-10 s lead-time target and v_max 3 m/s lets the creeper cross the line before green ends the window, shortening the first delay.

Targets M9a (s00 0.36 vs obs 0.33 per cycle), M10a (0.21 vs 0.27) and M9b/share_blocked (0.11 vs 0.02): q = 20 m and v_creep 4 m/s as in s00, p_right_lane lowered 0.04 -> 0.03 to reduce blocked right-turners, p_sidewalk raised 0.04 -> 0.05 to lift the sidewalk count toward 0.27 per cycle. p_wrong_lane stays 0 (inapplicable on the proxy net, R27). Shorter queues from the faster car-following should also lower M10b/M9c.

reasoning: All it01 specs share the same dominant errors: queues 70+ m, headways 2-4x too long, red running and early start near zero. Main change: faster car-following (lower tau, higher accel, smaller minGap) for cars and motorcycles; raise swarm p0 and early-start p; keep seeking near s00 values; lower jmTimegapMinor.
